title.narrative: Disaster Risk Reduction for resilient societies in Central Asia

description.narrative:
UNESCO supports its Member States in strengthening knowledge of technical and policy aspects related to disaster risk reduction, in particular on: 1) early warning systems; 2) science, technology and innovation, including artificial intelligence; 3) school safety; 4) resilience of UNESCO designated sites; 5) built environment; 6) nature-based solutions, 7) risk governance; and 8) post-disaster response. These efforts are implemented through a multi-hazard, multidisciplinary and multi-stakeholder approach. All activities will be aligned with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030, SDGs 1, 4, 9, 11, 13 and 15, and the Paris Agreement.
Central Asia region is highly exposed and vulnerable to various natural hazards such as earthquakes, landslides and mudflows. This activity will focus on enhancing resilience of populations in Central Asia by improving risk knowledge, building capacities of young professionals in DRR, and fostering regional cooperation. Cooperative networks will be further strengthened to serve as platforms for knowledge and experience sharing among stakeholders contributing to resilience building at national and regional levels.
